posts.title: Improving language negotiation
posts.description: Being a multilingual user on the web can sometimes be a frustrating experience. Depending on the device you’re using and the language it happens to be configured to, some websites will try to accommodate you, and give you a translated version of their content, even though you may prefer the non-translated original.
